name: ollum-sales
description: Two coordinated ChatGPT sales chats, persistent grounded CRM memory, and operator-controlled WhatsApp outreach.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate inbound and prospecting chats from ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Turns two isolated ChatGPT chats into one coordinated Ollum sales operation: complete company onboarding once, share persistent CRM memory, handle inbound WhatsApp events separately from prospecting, track replies, and keep every external send behind exact-recipient approval.
defaultPrompt: Настрой Ollum Sales и покажи инструкции для двух рабочих чатов.
Работай как чат входящих: проверь новые обращения и подготовь безопасные ответы.
Работай как чат новых компаний: проведи SAFE-анализ и покажи топ-5.
